items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Allan Reuss was a master. He was with Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: I do that with the banjo, yeah. That’s what they wanted. Allan Reuss was a master. He was with Benny Goodman. That boy who was with Tommy Dorsey. I know his name. Carmen Mastren. We know one another. Allan Reuss. And there was what’s­ his-name, with Basie.

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He's the first one that told me about Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: He's the first one that told me about Benny Goodman. He said, "Man..."
